segments.text: David Wood is a shameless psychopath. Inshallah he gets the help he needs and gets guided.
Yeah, I have a really hard time talking about David Wood in that way. I know that he's insulting
the Prophet, Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam, and that's despicable. It's vile.
But I just, you know, calling him a psychopath, he calls himself a psychopath, right? He says it about
himself. But the man has had a hard life. I think we have to have some. I guess I'm becoming
the compassionate Imam now. I guess I'm becoming the compassionate Imam now.
